title: A scene from a point-and-click comedy I made in conversations with Claude: a seller sends the deck as an attachment, and his boss wants to know if they opened it
author: Jutton

comments.author: Jutton
comments.body:
Free to play in the browser, no login: [https://connect.atlasgtm.io/sites/dale-stubbs-in-consumption/](https://connect.atlasgtm.io/sites/dale-stubbs-in-consumption/)

Workflow, since that’s the flair:

* All of it came out of conversations with Claude: scene art, dialogue, music, voices, the game engine.
* The art is vector canvas the model draws in code, no image generation, which is why it stays crisp at any size.
* Music and the mumble “voices” are synthesized in the browser, not recorded.
* Each version got pushed straight to hosting through an MCP connector, so iterating was “play it, say what’s wrong, play the new version.”

Disclosure: the connector and hosting are from my company. The game is free and not a product.

Happy to go deeper on any part, especially how the model handled scene layout vs. writing.
